name: Developer

board.title: Rail Yard Sweep
board.desc: The 3rd Cordon Battalion wants the freight track quiet. Neutralise 3 Bandits in the Barrens. They will remember.

board.title: Permit Survey
board.desc: The permit maps are nine years old. Walk 40 new map cells of Munincipal and extract with the survey.

board.title: Lights for the Checkpoint
board.desc: A checkpoint that cannot see shoots first. Restore power at a district substation.

board.title: The Ration Line
board.desc: Saint Agnes is feeding people the lists say do not exist. Extract with 3 cans of stew; they are taken from your stash when you are back.

board.title: The Pump Road
board.desc: The clean water is at the end of a street nobody can walk. Kill 8 infected in Residential.

board.title: Somebody's Neighbour
board.desc: Olena wants people brought in, not counted. Get 2 wounded strangers back on their feet, anywhere in the Zone.

board.title: Paper for Halberd
board.desc: The client pays for paper and does not say why. Recover and read 2 documents anywhere in the Zone.

board.title: Specimen
board.desc: Elias Mercer wants one of the changed ones confirmed dead: a Tank, a Spewer, a Bomber, the Butcher or a Gladiator. Any one. Anywhere.

board.title: Past the Cordon
board.desc: Kerosene wants to know the track is still open. Deploy into the Barrens and get out alive by any route. The cordon is not to know.

board.title: Shake the Lockers
board.desc: Cole Briggs wants to know what the cleanup crews left behind. Search 10 containers in Industrial.
